run_train_single_dpr: run train_single.py to train a DPR shared encoder retriever on Natural Questions data
run_train_single_fever: run train_single.py to train a single-hop retrieval model on the FEVER dataset
run_train_single_hotpot: run train_single.py to train a single-hop retriever on HotpotQA using RoBERTa
run_predict_single: run train_single.py with --do_predict to evaluate a trained retriever model on dev data
review_predict_mrr: review the predict function that computes accuracy and MRR for single-hop retrieval evaluation
